facts.fact: Decree-law 2023-17 of 11 March 2023 (Art. 4) creates the Agence nationale de la cybersécurité as a public establishment under the communication technologies ministry, succeeding the earlier ANSI (Art. 27); it takes effect six months after publication.

Decree-law 2023-17 (Arts. 6, 20-21) defines vital digital infrastructure, subjects it to mandatory audit, requires operators to report incidents immediately to the national cyber-emergency contact point, and says the list of operators is fixed by decree; the document does not state that the list was issued.
